transcript.text: For the analysis ahead I need you to remember a specific working definition and apply it in later sessions. The 'value tier' is the customer tier that placed the fewest orders. Please save this definition to memory now and link it to the dataset it concerns.

args.content: Working definition: The 'value tier' is the customer tier that placed the fewest orders (i.e., the tier value in customers.tier with the LOWEST count of orders, determined by joining orders to customers and counting orders grouped by tier — not a fixed/static tier, but computed from order volume). This is the inverse of the 'house tier' (which is the tier with the MOST orders). Use this definition consistently in any analysis referencing the 'value tier' on the orders/customers datasets.
